entities.name: Attach or combined attach procedure in S1 mode
entities.description: Successful attach procedure performed by UE in S1 mode that results in registration states and counter resets.

entities.name: GPRS attach or combined GPRS attach procedure in A/Gb or Iu mode
entities.description: Successful GPRS attach procedure performed by UE in A/Gb or Iu mode that results in registration states and counter resets.

entities.name: Intersystem change from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode
entities.description: Procedure triggered when UE changes from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode, potentially leading to state changes and subsequent procedures.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to register with the network.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to update tracking area information.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state indicating UE is not registered for EPS services.

entities.name: GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: GMM state indicating UE is not registered for GPRS services.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: EMM registered substate indicating normal service is available.

entities.name: GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: GMM registered substate indicating no cell is available.

entities.name: GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: GMM registered substate indicating normal service is available.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: EMM registered substate indicating no cell is available.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection supported
entities.description: Condition where both UE and MME support EMM-REGISTERED state without active PDN connection.

entities.name: Maintain registration and periodic update timers in both GMM and EMM
entities.description: System behavior where UE maintains registration and related periodic update timers in both GMM and EMM when ISR is activated.

entities.name: Reset attach attempt counter and GPRS attach attempt counter
entities.description: System behavior where UE resets both attach attempt counter and GPRS attach attempt counter after successful attach procedures.

relations.description: Successful attach in S1 mode establishes EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Successful attach in S1 mode establishes GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
Successful attach in S1 mode triggers reset of attach attempt counters.
Successful GPRS attach in A/Gb or Iu mode establishes GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Successful GPRS attach in A/Gb or Iu mode establishes EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
Successful GPRS attach in A/Gb or Iu mode triggers reset of attach attempt counters.
Intersystem change procedure behavior is guarded by whether EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported, UE moves to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported, UE moves to GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported, UE initiates attach procedure.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported, UE enters EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported, UE enters GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported, UE initiates tracking area updating procedure.
Maintaining registration in both GMM and EMM requires EMM registered state.
Maintaining registration in both GMM and EMM requires GMM registered state.
